academic_requirements.summary: A three-year university degree or suitable Italian/foreign qualification is required. L-8 and L-31 graduates are admitted without further curricular testing. Other graduates need at least 60 CFU across FIS/01-FIS/07, MAT/01-MAT/09, INF/01 and/or ING-INF/01-ING-INF/07, including at least 6 CFU in MAT and 6 CFU in INF/01 and/or ING-INF. Expected foundations include continuous/discrete mathematics, logic, algorithms and data structures, object-oriented programming, computer architecture, networks, operating systems, databases, computation models and resource management.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: A foreign qualification recognised as suitable; curricular equivalence is assessed by the programme committee.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Alternative route for applicants outside L-8/L-31.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: No absolute minimum stated; applicants below 88/110 undergo additional personal-preparation assessment.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Mandatory for applicants from other degree classes, for L-8/L-31 graduates below 88/110, and for applicants whose bachelor's degree is more than ten years old. Curriculum analysis may be followed by an interview.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: No ranking or quota is stated; enrolment follows a positive requirements assessment.

selection_components.notes: Required for applicants who trigger personal-preparation assessment.
Held only if the committee considers it necessary.

language_requirements.summary: English at CEFR B2 is required.
accepted_language_certificates: Valid B2-or-higher certificate included in the University Language Centre equivalence list
Other evidence of full B2 English, subject to committee assessment
certificate_exemptions: Degree certificate explicitly records passing full ENGLISH LANGUAGE B2 (not only individual skills)
language_requirements.notes: The study plan requires students without an Italian bachelor's degree to earn 3 CFU of Italian language skills at at least A2 during the degree; this is not stated as an entry condition.

application_windows.applicant_category: EU and equivalent applicants using ESSE3

Transcript/course list with grades, credits and subject sectors

required_documents.condition: Unless the degree certificate itself explicitly records full B2 English.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview
alternatives: Curriculum analysis alone where the committee does not require an interview
entry_exam_or_test.notes: There is no general admission test. An interview may follow curriculum analysis for applicants below 88/110, with a degree older than ten years, or from other degree classes.

tuition_amount_basis: University tuition is governed by the annual fees schedule; the programme page does not publish a programme-specific total. [uncertain]
